creature.prompt: A hunched, slow-breathing artillery beast that keeps to the middle distance. It lobs glowing radioactive mortars that blind whoever they land on, seeds the floor with a frost field that burns cold and roots anything caught in it, and wraps itself in an icy shell when pressed. Patient, methodical, never rushes in.
